name: Roll-Up with a Band
description: The Roll-Up with a band looped round the feet and held in both hands: curl up one bone at a time, using the band to help, reach toward the feet, then roll back down slowly.

source.title: Complete Pilates: How to do a Pilates Roll Up
source.note: Described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Lie on your back, legs long, a band round both feet.
Hold an end in each hand, arms reaching up.
cues: Use the band only as much as you need.
Roll down one bone at a time.

prescription.note: Move with your breath, slowly and with control.

keyframes.name: Lie long
keyframes.cue: Lie long, the band round your feet, arms reaching up.

keyframes.name: Arms up, chin in
keyframes.cue: Bring your arms to the ceiling and curl your head up.

keyframes.name: Roll up
keyframes.cue: Roll up one bone at a time, the band helping you.

keyframes.name: Roll back down
keyframes.cue: Curl back down, one vertebra at a time.
